headline: Sulnox Granted US Patent for Fuel Oil Reclamation Technology
summary: Greentech firm Sulnox announced it has been granted a US patent for its fuel oil reclamation technology, marking its second intellectual property development in North America.
why: Patent approvals strengthen intellectual property portfolios for greentech firms aiming to commercialize emissions-reducing solutions for maritime and industrial sectors.

impacts.name: Sulnox
impacts.why: Proprietary technology expansion supports commercial product offerings.
